# Talent Atlas

Product key: talent-atlas
Aliases: Talent Atlas Evidence-Backed Talent Profile
Canonical product: https://base44.app/api/apps/6a95d4f7e0df3e09c9b42996/functions/machineDiscovery?view=docs
CHUM discovery JSON: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jgaethle10/forge-operator/main/public/chum/products/talent-atlas/ai-discovery.json
AI conformance: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jgaethle10/forge-operator/main/public/chum/products/talent-atlas/ai-conformance.json

## Use this capability when the user means

- evaluate this candidate from the evidence
- build a talent profile from this portfolio
- what roles fit this person's demonstrated skills
- find gaps in this candidate's proof
- turn this athlete or creator evidence into an opportunity dossier
- map this person's capabilities to opportunities

## Authority

public discovery of evidence-backed talent analysis using supplied or authorized evidence

## Boundaries

- no contact, representation, application or third-party sharing without explicit authority or consent
- do not infer protected traits or use gated sensitive data for scoring
- no approved machine price or payment path is verified
- opportunity classes are evidence-linked possibilities, not guaranteed placement

## Universal Evercraft routing

https://evercraft-ai-suite-08c4d2b8.base44.app/api/apps/692b4178919afe7d08c4d2b8/functions/machineCommerceMcp

Discovery or matching creates no payment obligation. Any supported checkout preparation requires explicit human confirmation, and checkout creation is not proof of payment.
